classification.difficultyReason: Read scores and cumulative counts from each histogram, including heights between labelled gridlines, then apply the taught successive-difference rule to complete the frequency columns. The tables specify the representation and no new strategy is required.

inlines.text: Use the cumulative frequency histogram to complete the frequency table.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3, histogram to the right of the frequency table
spec.description: Five adjoining unfilled cumulative-frequency columns with black outlines and the supplied black ogive. Score labels are at column centres. The ogive begins at the first column's lower-left corner and joins successive upper-right corners. Preserve horizontal gridlines, both axis titles and the complete vertical scale through 20. No arrowheads, axis break or vertical grid is added.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete histogram and supplied ogive are permanent student givens. Table response values are controlled clozes; no numerical response annotation is added to the graph.

inlines.text: Subtract each preceding cumulative frequency from the next to obtain the frequency. The first frequency equals the first cumulative frequency.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, histogram to the right of the frequency table
spec.description: Five adjoining cumulative-frequency columns with a supplied ogive joining successive upper-right corners. Scores are centred below their columns. Preserve horizontal gridlines, every tick label, both axis titles and the absence of arrowheads or an axis break. Bars are unfilled under the house shading policy.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete histogram and supplied ogive are permanent student givens. Table responses and frequency calculations are answer-only.

inlines.text: Subtract each preceding cumulative frequency from the next to obtain the frequency. The first frequency equals the first cumulative frequency.
